title: Frozen Judges, Moving Agents: Version-Dependent LLM-Judge Error and the Limits of Judge-Assisted Agent Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2609.34198v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language-model judges compare agent upgrades with their predecessors, but a fixed judge can make version-dependent mistakes. We analyze 35 public coding-agent submissions (20 prespecified version pairs on 250 SWE-bench Verified issues), two customer-service agents (155 tau-bench tasks), and 1,106 expert-labeled AgentRewardBench trajectories. An upstream outage left three judges for the primary SWE-bench analysis (8,743 aligned cells); the fourth is descriptive. All three coding-agent judges and all four tau-bench judges reject task-conditioned error invariance after multiplicity adjustment. On SWE-bench, 32 of 60 judge-by-pair units have a detectable differential comparison component; eight judge-only intervals declare upgrades that execution-based intervals cannot establish, despite rank correlations of 0.71-0.79. In tau-bench, one judge reverses a nine-point reference-reward gap by penalizing a procedural habit the reward ignores.

translated_title: 冻结的裁判，流动的智能体：LLM裁判错误的版本依赖性与裁判辅助智能体评估的局限
translated_abstract: 语言模型裁判被用于比较智能体升级版本与其前代版本，但固定的裁判可能会产生版本相关的错误。我们分析了35个公开的编程智能体提交版本（在250个SWE-bench Verified问题上预设的20个版本对）、两个客服智能体（155个tau-bench任务），以及1,106条经专家标注的AgentRewardBench轨迹。由于上游服务中断，主要SWE-bench分析仅使用了三个裁判（8,743个对齐单元格），第四个裁判仅作描述性分析。经过多重性调整后，所有三个编程智能体裁判和全部四个tau-bench裁判均拒绝了任务条件下的误差不变性假设。在SWE-bench上，60个“裁判×版本对”单元中有32个存在可检测的差异化比较成分；尽管排名相关性达到0.71–0.79，仍有八个仅基于裁判的置信区间判定出了执行式评估区间无法确立的升级效果。在tau-bench中，一个裁判因惩罚奖励机制所忽略的某种程序性习惯，逆转了九个百分点的参考奖励差距。
tldr: 该研究通过大规模实证分析发现，固定的LLM裁判在评估智能体版本升级时会犯版本相关的系统性错误，可能误判升级效果甚至逆转真实的性能差距，揭示了依赖LLM裁判辅助评估智能体的可靠性局限。
en_tdlr: This study shows through large-scale empirical analysis that fixed LLM judges make version-dependent errors when comparing agent upgrades—potentially endorsing upgrades that execution-based evaluation cannot confirm and even reversing true reward gaps—revealing the limits of judge-assisted agent evaluation.
